files.description: Bike-share stations (48 rows, one per station): station_code (four-digit code with leading zeros, e.g. "0040"), station_name (text, a few with accented letters), district (same 6 districts as riders.csv; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), docks (whole number), opened_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD).

task_text: From stations.csv, build a web-address-style slug for each station_name: lower-case, accented letters replaced by their plain base letter (é becomes e, ü becomes u, å becomes a), and spaces replaced by hyphens, so Café Müller North becomes cafe-muller-north. `result` should be a Series of slugs indexed by station_code (text, leading zeros kept), in file order.
intended_computation: Read stations.csv keeping station_code as text; slug of station_name: lower case, accented letters replaced by their base letter (é->e, ü->u, å->a), spaces replaced by hyphens; a Series of slugs indexed by station_code in file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros
